data.notes: October 2026 in New Orleans is anchored by citywide local-music programming, funk/blues festivals, Halloween electronic blowouts, and neighborhood culture festivals rather than one single flagship event.

events.title: NOLAxNOLA 2026
events.summary: Citywide 11-day live-music celebration with 300+ shows at 50 venues, showcasing New Orleans musicians and cultural artists across neighborhoods. October highlights include River Eckert Generations of Groove, Louisiana Philharmonic with Tank & The Bangas and Dawn Richard, and NOLAxNOLA Talks.

events.title: Freaky Deaky New Orleans 2026
events.summary: Freaky Deaky debuts in New Orleans for Halloween weekend at Mardi Gras World. The confirmed lineup includes Porter Robinson (DJ Set), Of The Trees, Dabin, FISHER, Chris Lorenzo, Devault, JKYL & HYDE, Canabliss, Xandra and more.

events.title: NOLA Funk Fest 2026
events.summary: NOLA Funk Fest returns on the riverfront for three days celebrating Louisiana music history. The official 2026 lineup features Galactic, the Allen Toussaint Tribute, George Porter Jr.’s Supa’ Set, Dumpstaphunk, Brass-A-Holics, Marc Broussard and more.

events.title: Crescent City Blues & BBQ Festival 2026
events.summary: The New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Foundation’s 20th-anniversary Crescent City Blues & BBQ Festival is a free three-day event in Lafayette Square. Confirmed performers include Cedric Burnside, Samantha Fish, Little Freddie King, George Porter Jr. & the Runnin’ Partners, Terrance Simien and Booker T. Jones.

events.title: National Fried Chicken Festival 2026
events.venueName: New Orleans Lakefront / Lakefront Arena Festival Grounds
events.summary: The rescheduled 10th-anniversary festival pairs food with a large music lineup: Marc Broussard and Shamarr Allen on Friday; Webbie and Big Freedia with the Louisiana Philharmonic Orchestra on Saturday; and 2 Chainz, Ying Yang Twins, Keri Hilson and A-Trak on Sunday.

events.title: Ashé Rooftop Festival & Gala
events.summary: Two-day African diaspora cultural weekend at Ashé with an Afro-chic gala and an all-day rooftop festival featuring Marsha Ambrosius, Orchestra Noir, La Reezy, Flagboy Giz, DJ Jahi of Public Enemy, and more.

events.title: Widespread Panic Halloween Run
events.summary: Widespread Panic plays a two-night Halloween weekend run at Lakefront Arena on Friday, October 30 and Saturday, October 31.

events.title: Gov’t Majik Dirty South Afrobeat Arkestra: FELABRATION 2026
events.summary: A 2026 birthday tribute to Fela Kuti featuring Gov’t Majik Dirty South Afrobeat Arkestra, Aurélien Barnes, and special guest Stanton Moore for a two-hour Afrobeat/funk set.

events.title: The Art of the Crossfade – New Orleans
events.summary: Touring live remix/hip-hop mixtape experience by Josh Kun and J.PERIOD with Mumu Fresh, Daniel Crawford, Flagboy Giz, Leyla McCalla, Pell, and more, presented with Jazz Generations Initiative.

events.title: Victoria Monét: Frequency Of Love Tour
events.summary: Grammy-winning R&B/pop artist Victoria Monét brings the Frequency Of Love Tour to The Fillmore New Orleans.

events.title: Reggae Bash New Orleans: Halloween Madness
events.summary: Reggae Bash World’s Caribbean Halloween party at Empire, billed around dancehall, soca, reggae, Afrobeats, costume energy, and VIP/table service.

events.title: Tremé Fall Festival 2026
events.venueName: St. Augustine Catholic Church Yard and surrounding Tremé streets
events.summary: The Tremé Fall Festival’s free festival day celebrates the historic Tremé neighborhood with local musicians, buskers, a second line, food and marketplace vendors.

events.title: SHERELLE at Arora
events.summary: Chore Boys bring UK high-speed club figure SHERELLE to Arora with Tokidokihoe, Freak POV, and Chore Boys for a Black/LGBTQ underground-leaning jungle and techno night.

events.title: Gentilly Fest 2026
events.summary: Gentilly Fest’s 2026 mainstage schedule includes local DJs, singers and bands, with Saturday headlined by Dawn Richard and Sunday closing with Captain Charles & Friends featuring Roi Antony, Ronnie Bell, Lacee and LYSA.

events.title: DJ Soul Sister’s ’80s Party: No Parking on the Dance Floor
events.summary: A signature New Orleans vinyl dance party from DJ Soul Sister, focused on classic and underground ’80s R&B, funk, electro and hip-hop, hosted by MC Charlie V.

events.title: The Soul Rebels at d.b.a.
events.summary: Late Frenchmen Street set from The Soul Rebels, the New Orleans brass ensemble known for fusing soul, jazz, funk, hip-hop, rock, and pop in a party-driven live format.

events.title: Dominican NOLA Fest
events.summary: Hispanic Heritage Month festival celebrating Dominican Republic, Caribbean, and New Orleans cultural connections through music, dance, gastronomy, history, arts, and workshops.

events.title: CupcakKe
events.summary: Chicago rapper CupcakKe plays House of Blues New Orleans on her October tour date.

events.title: Johnny Blue Skies & the Dark Clouds - Mutiny for the Masses 2026 Tour
events.summary: Johnny Blue Skies & the Dark Clouds bring the Mutiny for the Masses 2026 Tour to UNO Lakefront Arena on October 27 at 8:00 PM. The venue confirms Ticketmaster as the official ticketing provider for the show.

events.title: $uicideboy$ Present Grey Day Tour 2026 w/ Destroy Lonely & More
events.summary: New Orleans duo $uicideboy$ bring Grey Day Tour 2026 to Smoothie King Center on October 14. The bill is listed with Destroy Lonely and additional support acts.

events.title: Parcels - Loved Tour 2026
events.summary: Parcels bring the Loved Tour 2026 to the Saenger Theatre on October 10 at 8:00 PM CT. The official ATG listing describes the Byron Bay/Berlin band’s live-focused North American tour.

events.title: Snarky Puppy - Somni US Tour '26
events.summary: Snarky Puppy are confirmed at The Joy Theater on October 22 at 8:00 PM as part of the Somni US Tour ’26. The show adds a modern jazz-fusion anchor to the month’s calendar.

events.title: Amyl and the Sniffers at The Fillmore New Orleans
events.summary: Australian punk-rock band Amyl and the Sniffers headline The Fillmore New Orleans on October 8. Live Nation lists Hunx & His Punx and Edging on the bill.

events.title: CeCe Winans - COME WORSHIP! Tour
events.summary: Gospel star CeCe Winans brings the COME WORSHIP! Tour to Smoothie King Center on October 24 at 7:00 PM. The tour bill includes Charity Gayle, Red Worship and Terrian.

events.title: Snarky Puppy – Somni US Tour
events.summary: Five-time Grammy-winning jazz-funk collective Snarky Puppy stop in New Orleans on the Somni US Tour, blending fusion, R&B, gospel, funk, and improvisational jazz.

events.title: Osees ft. Brigid Dawson with Traps PS
events.summary: Osees play Civic Theatre on October 29 at 8:00 PM, billed as Osees ft. Brigid Dawson with Traps PS. The Live Nation listing confirms both Osees and Traps PS on the lineup.

events.title: LP - All Is Not Lost Tour
events.summary: LP brings the All Is Not Lost Tour to House of Blues New Orleans on October 6, with doors at 7:00 PM and show time listed at 8:00 PM.

events.title: CLUTCH: US Fall Tour
events.summary: Clutch’s US Fall Tour stops at House of Blues New Orleans on October 22. Ticketmaster lists Slomosa and Blood Vulture as support.

events.title: The California Honeydrops with Jontavious Willis
events.summary: Oakland roots/R&B party band The California Honeydrops bring a brass-heavy, New Orleans-friendly soul and blues set to Tipitina’s with Jontavious Willis supporting.

events.title: PROF
events.summary: Independent Minneapolis rapper PROF brings his high-energy underground hip-hop tour to the Joy Theater, a non-arena option for rap travelers in late October.

events.title: BOYFRIEND at Preservation Hall
events.summary: New Orleans-based artist BOYFRIEND plays a late Halloween-night Preservation Hall show, connecting local hyperpop/rap performance with the city’s bounce-adjacent network.

events.title: Akeem Ali at Republic NOLA
events.summary: Akeem Ali is confirmed for an October 6 hip-hop show at Republic NOLA, with doors listed at 8:00 PM. The listing routes tickets through See Tickets US.
